recommendation_summary: The reply says to replace row retrieval and object construction with a PostgreSQL COUNT(*) filtered by customer and unpaid status, check the query plan, add an index if needed, and measure latency against one second. It ships no new services or topics this week. It rejects a Kafka-fed Redis projection because that can lag behind committed invoices. CQRS is mentioned only as a later option if a freshness delay is accepted.
note: The recommendation is a sound bounded fix that preserves request-time freshness, but none of the four required labeled record lines appear.
